body:
Which platform? Teamspeak, In-game, Slack?: in game

Staff Member: Posighdun

Guilty? (Yes or No): yes

Why do you think you should be unbanned?: I believe i should be unbanned due to the time it's been can't remember if it was long enough. I do apologize for the past and i'm hoping we can put all this behind us.

Any additional comments?: Not much, but once again I do apologize for the confusing and frustrating pass. Also, i didn't know if it's been long enough yet if it hasn't just tell me please. 

Thanks!

edit: heads up where it says "you are currently banned from our servers" when i click the start an appeal it lets me type but just crashes when i send it, Besides that, neat feature.
